rules.sql: SELECT record_id, COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis GROUP BY record_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: record_id is a deterministic SHA-256 hash of the grain (cik, fiscal_year). Duplicates indicate a computation or dedup guard bug.

rules.description: Every row has valid cik (exists in consumable.company_financials)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis aa WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumable.company_financials cf WHERE cf.cik = aa.cik)
rules.rationale: All amendment analysis CIKs must exist in the source company_financials table. Orphan CIKs indicate a build bug.

rules.description: No null amendment_count (every row has a count)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis WHERE amendment_count IS NULL
rules.rationale: Every summary row must have an amendment count. Null indicates a build bug.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis WHERE amendment_count <= 0
rules.rationale: Only years with amendments produce rows. A row with amendment_count=0 should not exist.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis WHERE mean_abs_change < 0
rules.rationale: ABS() ensures all magnitude stats are non-negative. A negative value indicates the build pipeline failed to apply ABS.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis WHERE median_abs_change < 0
rules.rationale: ABS() ensures all magnitude stats are non-negative.

rules.description: max_abs_change >= median_abs_change (max is at least as large)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis WHERE max_abs_change < median_abs_change
rules.rationale: The maximum must be at least as large as the median. Violation indicates a computation bug.

rules.description: distinct_concepts <= amendment_count (can't have more distinct concepts than amendments)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis WHERE distinct_concepts > amendment_count
rules.rationale: Each amendment has exactly one concept. Distinct concepts cannot exceed total amendment count.

rules.description: All 20 companies represented in the table
rules.rationale: EDA confirms all 20 companies have amendment data. Missing companies indicate a build or join bug.

rules.description: total_val_impact >= max_abs_change (total is at least as large as max)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.amendment_analysis WHERE total_val_impact < max_abs_change
rules.rationale: total_val_impact is the sum of all absolute changes. It must be at least as large as the single largest change.
